svg.data-cpu: Standard - Intel Denverton 2-core @1.6GHz; Premium - Intel Denverton 4-core @1.6GHz
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER/ZR (datasheet Compatible Transceivers; 80 km / 1G-10G per HIG Port Overview)
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A; BSMI; MTCTE

circle.data-description: HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (main board 3.3V power fail, or fan not present), Solid Green (fan present and interrupt de-assert), Blinking Yellow (fan present but interrupt assert). The table's Blinking Green and Solid Yellow rows read N/A and are deliberately not modelled

HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (main board 3.3V power fail, or fan not present), Solid Green (fan present and interrupt de-assert), Blinking Yellow (fan present but interrupt assert). The table's Blinking Green and Solid Yellow rows read N/A and are deliberately not modelled

circle.data-states: off ok standby fw-update critical input-lost warning
circle.data-description: S6301-56ST HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Green (output ON and OK), Blinking Green 1/sec (standby state, input present, only +5VSB on), Blinking Green 2/sec (power supply firmware updating, boot-loader mode - same colour and behaviour token as standby, the table separates them only by blink rate), Yellow (critical event causing shutdown: failure, over current, short circuit, over voltage, fan failure, over temperature), Blinking Yellow 1/sec (power cord unplugged or input lost with the second supply still fed; or input present with 5VSB and 12V off via system control), Blinking between Green and Yellow (warning events where the supply continues to operate: high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)

circle.data-states: off ok standby fw-update critical input-lost warning
circle.data-description: S6301-56ST HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Green (output ON and OK), Blinking Green 1/sec (standby state, input present, only +5VSB on), Blinking Green 2/sec (power supply firmware updating, boot-loader mode - same colour and behaviour token as standby, the table separates them only by blink rate), Yellow (critical event causing shutdown: failure, over current, short circuit, over voltage, fan failure, over temperature), Blinking Yellow 1/sec (power cord unplugged or input lost with the second supply still fed; or input present with 5VSB and 12V off via system control), Blinking between Green and Yellow (warning events where the supply continues to operate: high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)
